meta.title: Real drug wells, up close
meta.sub: one treated spheroid per mechanism class at a late timepoint; the full frame, toggle the AI outline, click a thumbnail

items.label: Untreated control
items.note: The baseline: a stimulated well left untreated stays a dense, cohesive cluster. Every drug shift below is measured relative to this.

items.label: Ibrutinib (BTK inhibitor)
items.note: Blocks the B-cell receptor at BTK, the axis that maintains adhesion. Inferred cell-cell shift +0.67 (not significant): loosening as predicted, but weak.

items.label: AMD070 (CXCR4 antagonist)
items.note: Blocks stromal homing (CXCR4). Inferred shift +4.12 (borderline): a modest loosening, though CXCR4's real target is niche adhesion, not cell-cell.

items.label: PD098059 (MEK inhibitor)
items.note: The only class clearing the significance heuristic. Inferred shift -7.94 (significant): the cluster compacts inward, solidity rises (n=4, one patient).

items.label: Bay 11-7082 (NF-kB inhibitor)
items.note: Blocks a central survival hub and is pro-apoptotic. Inferred shift -5.65 (borderline): a large negative move, plausibly entangled with drug-induced shrinkage.

items.label: Ruxolitinib (JAK inhibitor)
items.note: Targets the cytokine (JAK-STAT) arm of the stimulus rather than the BCR. Inferred shift +0.48 (not significant): the adhesion is left essentially unchanged.

note: Real drug-well frames, the full field, normalised to their own range as the pipeline does, with the AI outline in gold. Toggle it off for the frame alone. Each note gives the class's inferred cell-cell adhesion shift; it is a relative, inferred parameter, not a physical measurement.
